method: All through-via circular drill holes versus every SMD copper and paste shape on both sides, including same-net. Native rounded/custom pad shapes; paste uses ClonePad resized by loaded GetSolderPasteMargin(layer), including ratio. Includes standalone EP paste apertures. Uses native Collide(point, drillradius) for overlap and binary search of Collide(point, drillradius+gap) to 1nm for nominal edge clearance; SHAPE.Distance is deliberately not used. All loaded paste margins are zero or negative; holes are also checked against the unshrunk native copper/aperture envelope, so no conclusion depends on assuming a reduced corner radius. Nominal CAD geometry only; fabrication/registration tolerances are separate.
